rationale: The bid-ask spread of 94.4 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that requires a large move just to break even, making any entry unfavorable on a risk-adjusted basis. Price is currently at the session high (100% of range) after a strong intraday rally from $30.26 to $31.68, meaning a long entry chases extended momentum with limited upside before prior-day resistance near $32.15, while a short entry fights clear upward price action and elevated relative volume supporting the move. The reward-to-risk profile in either direction does not justify committing capital given the wide spread and positioning at the top of the range.
